integrity: Proof independently reconstructs the reset-age law and weighted-mean uniqueness; the double-logarithmic asymptotic is analytic. Numeric checks are corroborative and no independent review or priority certification is claimed.
limitations: Statement is for random reset-age fluctuations of the Thomas–Fermi hydrodynamic mean-field density, not for finite-particle quantum density noise.
Slow-reset limit is formal after the large-particle-number self-similar reduction; finite-particle validity is not asserted.
No claims for non-Poisson resetting or monotonicity of threshold with resetting rate.
title: A unique spatial anticorrelation front in a reset-expanding Thomas–Fermi condensate
